exercises.why: **учительница** — учи́тельница: female teacher, female instructor. Wiktionary: учи́тель + -ница.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: relating to school or learning, academic, training
female pupil, schoolgirl; female pupil, apprentice; female disciple, follower
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: учи́тельница — female teacher, female instructor; уче́бный — relating to school or learning, academic, training; поуча́ть — (dated) to teach, to instruct; учени́ца — female pupil, schoolgirl; female pupil, apprentice; female disciple, follower.
**ученицы** — учени́ца: female pupil, schoolgirl; female pupil, apprentice; female disciple, follower. Wiktionary: учен(и́к) + -и́ца.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
